MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.

3. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

7. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
